featured_reviews.name: Vidhish Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely poor and unreliable service.

My shipment (M53105780), which was supposed to be delivered on 21 February, has now been declared “not traceable” — in simple terms, DTDC has lost my package.

What is worse is the complete lack of accountability. Despite multiple follow-ups, there has been no proper resolution, no clear explanation, and no proactive communication from their side.

This shipment contained important items, and due to their negligence, I am now forced to incur additional expenses and inconvenience.

This clearly reflects a serious deficiency in service. If this issue is not resolved promptly with fair compensation, I will be escalating this matter through consumer grievance forums.

I strongly advise others to think twice before trusting DTDC with important shipments.

On checking your website, it was found that the booking was cancelled by SARASWATI GAS DISTRIBUTORS (Distributor Code 124336), Naigaon West.

Earlier they assured us that it will reach our home in the first week of April 2026.

Their phone number is also busy.

What is the problem?

Even one cylinder on our nephew's card number was given to someone else. It was not booked by him and it is not marked on his card.

In the meantime, we have booked another cylinder refill today.
